fact: The Ministry of Health's Annual Health Statistical Tables and Figures 2024 states that the January-December 2024 data, from 11,805 public and private health facilities, was recorded at the point of care on HMIS registers and tally sheets, aggregated by the facility at each month's end and then entered into the DHIS2 platform at council level; it gives no count of facilities entering their own reports.
title: Annual Health Statistical Tables and Figures 2024
